title: Adjunct Instructor - Management - John Chambers College of Business and Economics
description:
The Department of Management ( https://business.wvu.edu/academics/management-department
) at West Virginia University invites applications for part-time
adjunct positions. Potential areas of need include undergraduate
and graduate courses in principles of management, organizational
behavior, human resource management, entrepreneurship, strategy,
and international business.

The successful candidate will be responsible for in-person and/or
online courses for the undergraduate or graduate programs in the
Chambers College of Business and Economics.

Applications will be accepted throughout the year and will be
considered as openings arise. Salary is established on a per-course
basis.

Qualifications :

Master's degree in management/business or related fields such as
economics, psychology, sociology is required.

Please submit via PDF file (a) a letter of application summarizing
your teaching qualifications, (b) your curriculum vitae, including
professional certifications and professional experience, and (c)
contact information for two individuals who can provide letters of
recommendation.
